name: Implementing ISO/IEC 42001: Building an AI Management System
description: An implementation course for ISO/IEC 42001: defining scope and roles, gap assessment, integrating with an existing ISO management system, building the risk and impact assessment methods, implementing Annex A controls in engineering workflows, assembling documented information, running internal audit and management review, and preparing for Stage 1 and Stage 2 certification audits under ISO/IEC 42006.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Implementing ISO/IEC 42001: Building an AI Management System

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 20 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 25 questions, 50 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
